title: The methods for formulating the recommendations are clearly described.

chain_of_thought.step1_locate: Located in 'GUIDELINE DEVELOPMENT AND REVIEW PROCESS' section
step2_evidence: The guideline panel rated recommendations by using the GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation) method (11).

The draft guideline was sent to more than 15 expert reviewers inside and outside the federal sector. Comments were reviewed and, where appropriate, were incorporated into the final guideline based on panel consensus.
chain_of_thought.step3_reasoning: The guideline mentions using 'panel consensus' as the method for incorporating comments from expert reviewers, but does not describe the specific process (e.g., Delphi, voting) used to reach consensus. There is no description of consensus levels (e.g., 80% agreement) or how the consensus process specifically affected the final recommendations. The guideline provides the method name ('panel consensus') without any details about the process, results, or impact, which matches Score 2 (Provided recommendation generation method name only).
